# Boar for the Feast

*An envoys' feast in a week and the boar carts have not come. Hunt boars on the Thyme Banks for the carters, then tell Agnes the feast is on.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 30 [Downs Boar](../monsters/downs_boar.md) in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
2. Talk to [Agnes](../npcs/agnes.md)

## Rewards

- 5,100 EXP
- 500 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x15
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +100 standing with [Cuthbert](../npcs/cuthbert.md)
